semantics.actual_compact: 72 ordered surfaces / 29 exact source identities / 72 independent private resources
semantics.source_validation: one fresh signature per exact live source Resource identity per synchronous validation call, compared against every ordered per-surface admission signature
semantics.private_validation: all 72 private resources freshly signed independently
semantics.cache_lifetime: one _validate_contents call only; never crosses final, receipt, take, reset, generation or revision
semantics.scripted_materials: rejected before admission and before validation signature reads

performance_us_20_alternating_pairs.qualification: isolated hidden headless load-only CPU; no event, streaming, GPU, FPS or full-scene claim

decision.median_reduction: about 28-29 percent for final, receipt and take
decision.adoption_limit: 31-35 ms receipt/take remains outside event-frame and streaming budgets; production adoption requires an explicitly scheduled load/prewarm phase and owner review

limits: No burn values, callback order, HP, authority, debris launch or event integration is implemented.
Silent mutation restored to byte-identical admitted content before a validation boundary is observationally identical; a retained difference is caught by the fresh signature.
Resource.changed is an early sticky signal only and is not treated as the content proof.
The optional fused final-and-take API is outside this candidate.
